items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to switch customer sessions and escalate privileges, potentially leading to customer account takeover. Exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including several high-severity issues like stored cross-site scripting (CVE-2026-48413, CVE-2026-48414) and incorrect authorization flaws (CVE-2026-48415, CVE-2026-48416) that could lead to arbitrary code execution or security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, potentially leading to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (CVSS 8.7) could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring both authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security Feature Bypass) in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) could enable a security-feature bypass in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 6.5) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 2.7) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Critical Remote Code Execution in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of its Magento extensions, including two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Persistent Backdoors via Malicious Script Injection in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: The CosmicSting attack involves injecting malicious scripts into CMS blocks to create persistent backdoors on Adobe Commerce stores, with mass exploitation observed in the wild. A critical security fix was released around this time.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento allows attackers to write executable files to a store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento and Adobe Commerce allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Auth Bypass) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) in Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass security controls and gain unauthorized write access.
